final: WITH staff_totals AS (SELECT p.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS staff_amount FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY p.staff_id), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(staff_amount) AS total_amount FROM staff_totals) SELECT s.staff_id, s.staff_amount, CAST(s.staff_amount AS REAL) / g.total_amount FROM staff_totals AS s CROSS JOIN grand_total AS g WHERE g.total_amount IS NOT NULL
